name: Weekday Breakfast Prep
instructions: Pick one breakfast and make 4-5 servings at once (a big batch of oats, a tray of frittata muffins) -- variety is nice, but consistency beats decision fatigue on weekday mornings.
Store portions in grab-and-go containers in the fridge, and freeze any extra you will not eat within 4 days.
Add a piece of fresh fruit each morning rather than prepping that in advance, so it stays fresh.
Watch today's video for a full weekday breakfast prep session.
